notes.title: Optimization update v 0.0.8 O
notes.content:
[b]- Optimization update v.0.0.8 O - [/b]

[b]Technical Improvements & Optimization[/b]

-Landscape Optimization: Significant improvements to landscape rendering and foliage assets have been implemented, resulting in increased performance and higher frame rates across the map.

-Core Gameplay Optimization: A full pass on various gameplay systems has been completed, enhancing the game's overall performance and stability.

-Enemy AI Logic Refactor: The logic and movement code for all enemy AI has been completely refactored and optimized. This update yields an average 30% improvement in AI processing speed, leading to more responsive enemies and better overall CPU performance.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Inventory Persistence: Fixed an issue where save and load functions would improperly flush out certain inventory items. All items should now correctly persist upon loading a saved game.

- Re-building System Fix: Addressed and corrected save and load issues reported by users regarding the re-building system.

Please ensure your game is updated to the latest version to benefit from these changes. If you encounter any new issues, please report them on the Steam forums.

notes.title: Healing at the campfire Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone !

It has been quite some time since the last update regarding the prologue demo. I have been hard at work since the demo release with adding more features, fixing issues, balancing the game and making the game more user friendly.

More than 110 action items are knocked off the to do list which i see as a huge win.
- Redid character movement logic
- Redid a lot of movement animations
- Created more UIs for user information
- Created better crafting mechanics
- Camp takeover logic improved
- Improved battle mechanics
- Improved healing feature
- Created allied units updates


Please do follow the game here and on discord to know more about the updates.

In the image you can see the new units healing process. Player can create campfire and the units will automatically sit and rest near it.
It will heal the units and also reduce overall fatigue.

I am also hard at work on the game to meet the deadlines of the upcoming Steam festivals. Stay tuned for new demo in the festival !

tags.feature: - Redid a lot of movement animations
- Created more UIs for user information

notes.title: Demo build update 0.0.4.d
notes.content:
Hey everyone !

Bugs and QoL features updated
Here is the latest changelist:


[b]15/9[/b]
[olist]
[*] Save and Exit button is now working.
[*] Improve the village look in Main Menu
[*] Continue button in main menu is now disabled if no save file is found.
[/olist]

[b]14/9[/b]
[olist]
[*] 
[*] Archer mode now usable
[*] Armor slots were not loading after saving game.
[*] Small tree and Small stone initially HP reduced
[*] Bottom lip UI icon updates when the item is selected with scroll and middle mouse button click
[*] First hit on resource didnt play SFX
[*] Tutorial update changed, first to make a wooden torch
[*] Animals HP was not updating in mini HP UI
[*] Leather requirements reduced considerably for items that use iron for crafting
[*] Broken tree did not make hit resource sound.
[*] Bow and arrow items added in crafting list.
[*] When Allied units are following player, they will walk if player is walking, will run if player is running
[*] If there are any Allied units selected and Player is being attacked. Allied units will AUTO ATTACK the enemies
[*] When loading game from a saved game, units were duplicating
[*] Buildings that player created were not being loaded
[*] Resource collection did not have a HIT animation
[*] Mini HP bar on player hover was not auto updating
[*] Soft lock of Main hud + Squad creation.
[*] Escape works on Pause menu
[*] Objectives menu fight with other menu for screen space.
[*] Escape now works when want to exit Training UI
[*] Escape now works when want to exit Crafting UI
[*] HP bars added on animals
[*] Resources were just grey circles, now they show respective icon
[*] Player healing was not capped to MAX HP
[*] Saving and loading game was duplicating the resources
[*] Loading the game was not giving weapons in the slots
[*] Enemy scouts sees but still moves. When notices player or player soldiers, Scout should stay in place
[*] Kicking while resource collection, doesnt move the player any more
[*] Crafting UI soft lock solved.
[*] Distance check added on the interactable buildings.
[*] Village notice board interaction elements corrected.
[/olist]

Thanks, please keep the comments and discussions going and please join the discord so I can improve the game better.

notes.title: The Last King Demo now available on Steam
notes.content:
Hey everyone !


After months of hard work I am happy to release the demo version of The Last King.
In the demo you will be able to 
Survive in an open world by gathering resources, crafting weapons, building your base, freeing greek prisoners, recruiting greek villagers, training your units and capturing enemy territories.

A simple objective / tutorial has been updated to help kickstart your journey as The Last King.

Happy gaming

- Mani
